description: This file contains the implementation of the 'NotIn' validation rule class, which checks if a given input is not present in a specified list; it is part of a validation rules module in a Human Resource Management system.
external_files: PHP Standard Library functions if used

classes.name: NotIn
classes.description: A validation rule class that ensures a given value is not in a specified array, with optional strict comparison.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the NotIn rule with a list of disallowed values (haystack) and an optional strict comparison flag.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks whether the input value is not in the haystack array, respecting the strict comparison if set.
